headline: Not done. The Python 3 update failed and nothing was confirmed.
problems: The Homebrew package list refreshed, but that was not checked, so it proves nothing on its own.
Upgrading Python 3 failed with an error saying Python 3 is not installed through Homebrew.
The final check that Python 3 is up to date could not run, so there is no proof of the goal.
The new Python version was never checked because the process stopped at the failed upgrade.
